title: 2022 Score #65 Chris Godwin Tampa Bay Buccaneers Football Card

descriptionText: This 2022 Score sports trading card features Chris Godwin of the Tampa Bay Buccaneers. The card is part of the base set and has a card number of 65. It is perfect for any collector who is a fan of the National Football League (NFL) and is looking to add to their collection. The card is manufactured by Panini and is a great addition to any sports trading card collection. It is not autographed and is part of the 2022 season.
